messages.text: Can I swap out my BS-2 order for the Nexus S1
Yes, if the BS-2 line hasn't shipped yet I can do that swap right here. What's your order number, and the name or postcode ····?
Thanks. I need the email on the order to pull it up, then I can check the BS-2 line and price the swap to the Nexus S1.

Yes, Nicholas, I can do that. The B.2 hasn't shipped, and the US Nexus S1 is in stock.

Swapping the Bitfortun BS-2 ($360) for the Nexus S1 ($699) leaves a difference of $339.00. That gets invoiced to you by email, and it ships once it's paid, within about 5 business days.

Want me to make the swap?
That's the email on the order, thanks. So just say the word and I'll swap the BS-2 for the Nexus S1, with the $339.00 difference invoiced to that address. Do you want me to go ahead?
Is there a better price because of the issue with the BS-2

That's already been handled, Nicholas. Money went back to you on the 29th for the hashrate issue on the BS-2, so I can't put a second discount on top of it.

The swap itself stands as priced: the $360 you paid for the BS-2 comes straight off the Nexus S1, leaving $339.00 invoiced. Nothing for the swap itself.

Want me to go ahead?
And when would I get the Nexus?

There are four US units in stock, so it ships within 5 business days of the invoice being paid, out of the US warehouse. Tracking comes to your email when the label prints.

Say the word and I'll make the swap now so the invoice goes out tonight.
Handed to the team · swap_done, logged for Abel; warehouse line needs a check

Done, Nicholas. Order Shop···· now has the NEXUS S1 (10TH/s), US plug, in place of the BS-2. The invoice for the $339.00 difference goes to (email hidden) in a minute, and it ships from the US warehouse within 5 business days of that being paid. Tracking follows by email.

Anything else while I'm in the order?
Your B30 order, Shop····, is paid and unshipped. The B30 and the Power Kit ship November 7. Tracking comes to the same email when the label prints.
Before you go, one thing: what was actually going on with the BS-2's hashrate that made you want off it?
No the delay on the unit
Got it, the wait, not the chip. How long a wait on the BS-2 would still have been fine before you gave up on it?
That's useful. Your B30's been on order since August with a November date, though. What makes that wait worth it when the BS-2's wasn't?
The B30 seems to be a powerful unit
That's three, thanks Nicholas, genuinely useful. Watch for the invoice on the Nexus S1, and the tracking follows once it's paid.
That came through, the order shows nothing outstanding. So the Nexus S1 is clear to ship, within 5 business days from the US warehouse, and the tracking lands in your email when the label prints.
